modifications.description: RemoteHub 0.3.2: preserve complete mouse-wheel steps and fractional remainders on both axes, distinguish pixel/line/page units, and explicitly reject non-finite or excessive input above 1024 combined steps per event before emitting any pulses. RemoteHub 0.3.3: add validated wheelSensitivity (integer 1-8, default 1), scale normalized wheel distance, and clear pending fractions only when sensitivity changes.
